title: Kalaignar and Dr. Hande: “Not Third Grade; Fourth Grade Government!”
summary: When Dr. Hande attacked the government as 'third grade', Karunanidhi turned the slur into social justice thunder: 'Call it fourth grade, for it is the Shudras of the fourth varna who govern Tamil Nadu today!'
keywords: Kalaignar and Dr. Hande: “Not Third Grade; Fourth Grade Government!”
Kalaignar M. Karunanidhi & Dr. H. V. Hande
full_text:
In the early 1970s, the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly was renowned for its fierce oratorical clashes. Swatantra Party leader Dr. H. V. Hande was one of the sharpest opposition debaters, known for bombarding the treasury benches with uncomfortable facts.

During a heated session on administrative lapses, Dr. Hande lost his temper:
"Mr. Speaker! This administration is plagued by corruption and inefficiency. I declare openly: this is a third-rate government! A third-grade administration!"

The term 'third-rate government' caused an uproar. Ruling party MLAs sprang to their feet, slamming desks and demanding an immediate apology.

Chief Minister Kalaignar M. Karunanidhi stood up calmly. Raising his hands, he pacified his agitated colleagues:
"My friends, be seated! I have heard Dr. Hande's words. With the Speaker's permission, I shall reply!"

Silence returned to the house.

Karunanidhi adjusted his spectacles and spoke with theatrical majesty:
"Honorable Speaker! My esteemed friend Dr. Hande has characterized our government as 'third grade'. 
I do not understand why my colleagues are angry with him. 
In fact, I feel Dr. Hande was unnecessarily stingy in his description. Instead of calling us 'third grade', he should have been generous enough to call us a 'fourth-grade government'!"

A collective gasp swept through the assembly. Lawmakers stared at each other in confusion: *Was the Chief Minister agreeing that his government was inferior?!*

Then, Karunanidhi unleashed his masterstroke:
"Because under the ancient code of Manusmriti's Varnashrama, the first rank belongs to the Priest, the second to the Kshatriya, and the third to the Vaishya! 
It is the oppressed working people of the 'fourth varna'—the so-called Shudras—who have been denied dignity for millennia! Today, inspired by Thanthai Periyar and Arignar Anna, it is those very people of the fourth rank who govern this state! 
Therefore, if Manusmriti branded us fourth-grade citizens, we take immense pride in leading a fourth-grade government dedicated to liberating the downtrodden!"

The assembly chamber erupted in deafening cheers and table-thumping! 

Dr. Hande himself stood amazed. Karunanidhi had taken a routine insult and transformed it into a magnificent manifesto of social justice and democratic pride.
moral: Transforming an opposition insult into an empowering declaration of social emancipation, Karunanidhi illustrated the supreme art of political debate.
